match_boundary: A shared word in a company name or an email domain alone is not a reliable account match. Agency consultants may use their employer's domain while serving a different client.
authorized_action: Link only an exact, independently verified contact-account pair when the relationship endpoint persists the requested IDs and a subsequent relationship read confirms them.
stop_condition: The API returns a fixed Contact fixture for Accounts, does not expose the candidates, or cannot read back a persisted relationship.
